meta.title: Sectioned Feature Development
meta.description: Orchestrates sectioned feature development: cleanup and branch gating, plan review accounting, ES actor dispatch, wave budgets, advisor escalation, and side-panel progress.

cleanup.dirtyQuestion: The workspace has uncommitted changes. How should SFD proceed?
cleanup.onMain: On main. A feature branch will be created.
cleanup.branchNameQuestion: Confirm the feature branch name (from the feature slug):
cleanup.sameBehind: main is strictly behind this branch (ahead>0, behind=0).
cleanup.sameAhead: main is strictly ahead of this branch (ahead=0, behind>0).
cleanup.diverged: This branch and main have diverged (ahead>0, behind>0).
cleanup.inSync: This branch is in sync with main (ahead=0, behind=0).
cleanup.newFromCurrent: New branch from the current branch
cleanup.ffToCurrent: Fast-forward main to this branch first

state.notGit: The working directory is not a Git repository.
state.notRootAgent: /sfd requires the exact live root chat agent.
state.noCwd: No working directory for this session.
state.esMissing: external-subagent is required but not detected. Install it first: brew install external-subagent (or see its README), then run `external-subagent agents enable zcode codex`.
state.esProfileMissing: Required external-subagent profile(s) missing: {names}. Create them or use the panel's profile installer.
state.resume: Existing SFD state detected — resuming handoff briefing follows.
state.fresh: No SFD state found in this repository.
state.handoff: You (the main agent) now drive the start: first read the sectioned-feature-development skill, then determine the task to build. If this conversation has no task context yet, ask the user what they want before doing anything else. Once the task is known, call the sfd_start tool with a one-line taskSummary — it runs the workspace cleanup gate and creates the feature branch automatically. Do not run git branch/checkout yourself.
state.stopped: SFD start stopped by user. Nothing was changed in the repository state machine.
state.agentMergeHold: HOLD: merge the current branch with main and resolve conflicts first, then run /sfd again to resume.
state.nextPlan: Next: read the sectioned-feature-development skill, identify Feature(s) from the user request, and draft PLAN-FULL at .agent-work/PLAN-FULL.md. Automatic activation requires user approval of the first proportional plan before plan review.
state.legacyTitle: Existing SFD work markers found (no plugin state):
state.legacyBody: This may be an uncleaned previous run or a manual pre-plugin run. Decide: archive it and start fresh, continue it manually, or stop. The plugin cannot resume a run it did not record.
state.readSkillFirst: Read the sectioned-feature-development skill first, then continue from the phase above.

tool.existingRun: An SFD run already exists in this repository; use its brief above instead of starting a new one.
tool.agentMergeTask: Task for you (the main agent): merge the current branch with main, resolve all conflicts, commit the merge, then call sfd_start again to proceed to planning.
